notes.title: Bug fixes and gameplay improvements
notes.notes: This is the 4th update for Indie Playtest Fest. I fixed a few key issues that were confusing players.

notes.title: Latest build fixes broken URL link to feedback survey
notes.notes: This build also makes protein strings collide with dead aminos to make certain levels easier. We added some new hints to some levels too.

notes.title: Playtest bug fix
notes.notes: Fixed a critical bug that was causing the final Thank You screen not to show.
